name: Fairchild AFB
description: Home of the 92nd Air Refueling Wing. Fairchild AFB provides global air refueling with KC-135 Stratotankers and supports the Air Force Survival, Evasion, Resistance, and Escape (SERE) school.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival. Contact Fairchild Inn (509-244-2290) for after-hours arrivals. Attend Right Start orientation coordinated through M&FRC.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Fairchild Inn for initial arrival. Dormitory Management (509-247-3275) for unaccompanied housing. Family housing through Balfour Beatty (509-244-6500).

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC at 509-247-2246 if no sponsor is assigned before departure.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 92 FSS, M&FRC, and official Fairchild sites for in-processing and air refueling mission support.
